series.title: USDA ERS — Net farm income, states and U.S.
series.description: Original USDA ERS historical net farm income in publisher $1,000 units for all 50 states and the U.S. aggregate. State estimates extend through 2025; 2026 appears in the U.S. aggregate forecast and is not a state estimate.
